title: Video: Watch full interview with Syracuse chancellor, AD on their vision for SU sports
summary: Syracuse University's newly appointed Chancellor Mike Haynie and Athletic Director Bryan Blair, who assumed their positions in March 2026, have completed a six-month listening period across the university and are prepared to articulate their vision for SU sports. This leadership transition and strategic planning exercise may inform broader institutional priorities relevant to regional economic development and higher education partnerships.
